top_signals.title: Wetherspoon boss Tim Martin attacks government’s ‘unfriendly’ attitude to business
top_signals.summary: Wetherspoon boss Tim Martin has said he is “very concerned” by the wealth exodus gripping the UK as he hit out at Labour’s “unfriendly” attitude towards entrepreneurs.  The pub tycoon said it is “madness” to blame the number of ultra-rich businesspeople leaving the country on anything other than the business conditions created by the government.  [...]
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Revised CLARITY Act targets ‘non-decentralized’ DeFi operators
top_signals.summary: The bill’s ethics section remained largely unchanged despite being one of the main points of contention ahead of a pivotal Senate vote.
